panels.title: Big or small?
points: Big or unsafe worries: tell an adult today

keywords.def: a feeling that something might go wrong
a book where we write about our day

questions.q: Write a model diary entry together about a test worry.
questions.a: 'Monday. Worried. Spelling test. I practised and made du'a. Felt calmer.'

questions.q: Pupil PDF: write two diary entries from this week using the four parts.
Extend: pick a strategy to try tomorrow.
A worry won't go away and makes you feel unsafe. What do you do?
questions.a: A) Tell a trusted adult today. Big worries need an adult.

questions.q: Breathing for worries: in for 4, out for ...
Think again: Where do worries go when you keep them inside?
questions.a: They can grow. Writing or talking lets them out so we can deal with them.
